select msd.broker_id brockerId, /*所属券商ID */ (select to_char(wm_concat(secinfo.broker_name)) from mst_sale_department sale left join stl_capacct_info capacct on capacct.own_dept=sale.sale_depid left join stl_sec_acct_info secinfo on capacct.acct_no=secinfo.trd_acct_id where sale.sale_depid=msd.sale_depid) as brockername, /* 所属券商名称 */ msd.ip_addr IP, /* IP地址 */ msd.port_num MAC, /*端口 */ msd.ip_addr2 ipBack, /* 备用IP地址*/ msd.port_num2 macBack, /* 备用端口 */ msd.declare_unit orderUnit, /* 申报单位 */ msd.is_netreturn netPriceReturn, /* 净价回报 */ msd.inter_type agentType, /* 柜台接口类型 */ msd.handle_type specialBuss, /* 特殊处理业务*/ msd.serverinfo serverInfo from mst_sale_department msd
and msd.sale_depid =#{stockExchangeNo,jdbcType=VARCHAR}

select a.SALE_DEPID, a.SALE_DEPNAME, a.BROKER_ID, a.IP_ADDR, a.PORT_NUM, a.CONTACT_ADDR, a.CONTACT_TEL, a.FAX_NO, a.IP_ADDR2, a.PORT_NUM2, a.DECLARE_UNIT, a.IS_NETRETURN, a.HANDLE_TYPE, a.INTER_TYPE, a.CREATE_USER, a.CREATE_DEPT, a.CREATE_TIME, a.UPDATE_USER, a.UPDATE_TIME, a.SH_SEATNO, a.SZ_SEATNO, a.SERVERINFO, a.ZJ_SEATNO, a.SQ_SEATNO, b.customer_name as brokername from mst_sale_department a,(select * from mst_customer_info b where (b.IS_BROKER = 'Y' OR b.IS_FUTURE_COM = 'Y'))b where a.BROKER_ID = b.customer_id(+)
and a.BROKER_ID in (select REGEXP_SUBSTR(str, '[^,]+', 1, LEVEL) STR from (select #{brokerId} as str from dual) CONNECT BY LEVEL <= REGEXP_COUNT(str, '[^,]+'))
and a.INTER_TYPE in (select REGEXP_SUBSTR(str, '[^,]+', 1, LEVEL) STR from (select #{interType} as str from dual) CONNECT BY LEVEL <= REGEXP_COUNT(str, '[^,]+'))
and (a.SALE_DEPID like concat(concat('%',#{saledepname,jdbcType=VARCHAR}),'%') OR a.SALE_DEPNAME like concat('%',concat(#{saledepname},'%')))

select t.customer_id as id,t.customer_name as text from mst_customer_info t where (t.IS_BROKER = 'Y' OR t.IS_FUTURE_COM = 'Y')
AND (t.customer_id like concat(concat('%',#{brokerId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}),'%') OR t.customer_name like concat(concat('%',#{brokerId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}),'%'))
AND ((customer_id like concat(concat('%', #{search,jdbcType=VARCHAR}),'%')) or (customer_name like concat(concat('%', #{search,jdbcType=VARCHAR}),'%')) )
AND customer_id = #{initValue}
order by t.customer_id
SELECT T.CUSTOMER_ID AS id,T.CUSTOMER_NAME AS text , T.IS_BROKER AS isBroker , T.IS_FUTURE_COM AS isFutureCom FROM MST_CUSTOMER_INFO T WHERE T.customer_id = #{customerId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}
